## Build Failure Analysis

**Solution:** `BuildDiag.sln` (3 projects: `Core`, `Services`, `Api`)

---

### Root Cause (1 issue)

**Project: `Services.csproj`** — Missing NuGet package reference to `Newtonsoft.Json`

| Error | File | Line | Message |
|-------|------|------|---------|
| CS0246 | `Services/UserService.cs` | 2 | `using Newtonsoft.Json` not found |
| CS0246 | `Services/UserService.cs` | 3 | `using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq` not found |
| CS0246 | `Services/UserService.cs` | 22 | Type `JObject` not found |

The `Services.csproj` has **no `<PackageReference>` for `Newtonsoft.Json`**, yet `UserService.cs` uses types from that package (`JObject`, etc.). The `project.assets.json` confirms no NuGet packages are resolved — only the project reference to `Core`.

---

### Cascading Failure

**Project: `Api.csproj`** — Depends on `Services.csproj` via `<ProjectReference>`. It failed to build because its dependency (`Services`) failed first. `Api` has no errors of its own.

---

### Fix

Add the missing package reference to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

Then run `dotnet restore` and rebuild. This single fix resolves all 3 compile errors and unblocks the `Api` project.
